Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

Role Summary

Fanatics is building Fanatics Markets, and is aiming to be the biggest and best prediction market for Sports and Sports Culture. As part of that growth, we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define and drive the product experience for our prediction markets platform. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who leads with data, takes full ownership of their area, and knows how to ship. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, growth, and commercial teams to define what we build, prioritise ruthlessly, and make sure it lands. This role reports into Louis Sutton, our VP of Product, where you’ll be apart of a small and high performing product and design team.

Responsibilities

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll own the product roadmap for your area, from problem discovery to execution and iteration.
  • You’ll define success for what you ship, and drive the team to achieve that.
  • You’ll work with Design, Data and Engineering to ensure you’re solving the most important problem in your domain.
  • You’ll articulate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs and own your own success.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–5 years of product management experience in consumer-facing digital products
  • Numerically strong, you know how to use data to make decisions.
  • You’ve shipped products end-to-end
  • You have a high ownership mentality, and you treat problems as yours.
  • You’re a clear concise communicator (written and verbal)
  • You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments; able to balance pace with quality

Nice to Have

  • You’re AI native, and love using Claude (or whatever tool you prefer
  • Experience in fintech, sports, gaming or other fast paced consumer facing digital products
  • You’re a user of prediction markets, sportsbooks or other comparative products.

 

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

jobs.title: Product Owner - Agentic
jobs.description:
About Us  
 Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 
 
 Your Mission 
 As Senior Product Owner for our Agentic Team, your mission is to own the end-to-end roadmap for Hawk's suite of agentic products — spanning investigation, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting, and the core platform capabilities that support them. This is the hub for agentic development at Hawk today, and the role carries genuine responsibility for setting the standard for how (semi-)autonomous AI is built and governed in a regulated, high-stakes environment — where a wrong answer can mean a missed financial crime or a false accusation. Product strategy and vision are shaped in close alignment with leadership and stakeholders across adjacent product teams. The role requires the ability to articulate not only what these products do, but why they are built the way they are — and the commercial rationale for why customers should invest in them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the agentic roadmap end-to-end — from backlog prioritization and change/feature request triage through in-year roadmap execution — and be the final point of accountability for what actually ships.

 Shape product vision and multi-year strategy for the agentic line in close alignment with leadership and key stakeholders across the business. As the senior member of this team, this role carries more forward-looking, strategic weight than a typical PO — helping set direction, not just executing against it.

 Treat commercial ownership as core to the job, not adjacent to it: pricing, packaging, and CARR/revenue framing sit as close to this role as backlog grooming does.

 Be the face of the agentic product externally where it matters — representing the roadmap in customer advisory boards, competitive reviews, analyst conversations, and key/enterprise deal support.

 Act as the connective hub between the agentic team and adjacent screening, fraud, and KYC product teams, ensuring agentic capabilities integrate cleanly instead of bolting on.

 Keep the product legible to everyone who needs it: own documentation, product briefings, and the product newsletter, the artifacts that let engineering, sales, and customers understand what's being built and why.

 Run tight, agile delivery day-to-day with development and data science, keeping planning honest and timely without turning process into ceremony.
 

 Your Profile 
 3–5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, and 3–5 years in the financial industry — ideally with direct exposure to Anti-Financial Crime (AML, fraud, sanctions screening, KYC/CDD). We're open on the exact mix; what matters is that both sides are real, not adjacent.

 Demonstrable, hands-on experience building agentic products in a regulated environment, including familiarity with explainability, safety, accuracy monitoring, and bias considerations.

 Strong product operations instincts in a fast-moving environment: you run tight, agile processes without turning them into ceremony, adapt quickly when the ground shifts, and keep planning solid instead of firefighting.

 A sharp, decisive prioritizer with a genuine quality bar: you slice, scope, and rescope work under pressure, defend that scope when it's challenged, and know the difference between shipping fast and shipping sloppy — you don't trade one for the other without a reason.

 Commercial literacy as a working skill, not an afterthought. You think about pricing and packaging with the same seriousness you bring to feature scoping, because building the right thing and selling the right thing are two different jobs — and both are yours.

 A progressive, clear-thinking communicator. You have a real point of view on where agentic AI in financial crime is heading, you can defend it, and you can also explain the "how" and "what" when the room needs it — not just the vision.

 Genuinely curious about the agentic AI landscape as it evolves. You bring that outside perspective back into the product, translating what's newly possible into concrete roadmap ideas rather than chasing hype for its own sake.

 Genuinely customer-focused and stakeholder-minded: you engage directly with customers and treat their input — including complaints — as valuable signal rather than noise, and you give the same weight to input from engineering and other internal stakeholders.

Für unser Research & Development suchen wir einen Product Owner oder eine Product Ownerin, der bzw. die gemeinsam mit einem festen Entwicklungsteam unsere Cloud-Lösungen weiter voranbringt und den baramundi Proactive Hub im Bereich Big Data & Security maßgeblich mitgestaltet. 
 Am Standort Augsburg arbeiten interdisziplinäre Teams aus Softwareentwicklung, Testing, Scrum Mastering, Product Ownership und Agile Coaching an den Software-Produkten von morgen – zu 100 Prozent made in Germany. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Anforderungen zu verwalten, sondern Produktideen in klare, umsetzbare Schritte zu übersetzen, technische Komplexität greifbar zu machen und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. 
 Neben einem großartigen Team bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten, aktiv an der Produktentwicklung mitzuwirken und deine Ideen jederzeit einzubringen. 

 Tu, was du am besten kannst: SECURITY & COMPLIANCE INTELLIGENCE VORANTREIBEN Du verantwortest die Security-Säule des baramundi Proactive Hub – von Vulnerability Intelligence über Configuration Management bis hin zu Infrastructure Analytics. Du übersetzt komplexe Sicherheitsanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Produktinkremente und stellst sicher, dass IT-Teams proaktiv über Risiken informiert und handlungsfähig gemacht werden  
 DATA LAKEHOUSE & BIG DATA MITGESTALTEN  Du treibst gemeinsam mit deinem festen Entwicklungsteam den Aufbau einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren Dateninfrastruktur voran – als Core-Enabler für alle datengetriebenen Features des Proactive Hub. Dabei bringst du die Verarbeitungsgeschwindigkeit und -qualität unserer Daten auf ein neues Level 
 
 PLATFORM & INTEGRATIONS WEITERENTWICKELN  Du gestaltest den Ausbau der Proactive Hub Plattform aktiv mit – durch Integration externer Tools, Drittsysteme und Schnittstellen mit dem Ziel, den Hub zum zentralen Knotenpunkt im IT-Management-Ökosystem unserer Kunden zu machen 
 
 KI ALS PRODUKTBESTANDTEIL DENKEN  Du gestaltest KI-gestützte Features aktiv mit – von intelligenter Anomalieerkennung über LLM-basierte Assistenzfunktionen bis hin zu datengetriebenen Empfehlungen, die IT-Administratoren proaktiv und handlungsfähig machen  
 MIT DEINEM TEAM LIEFERN  Du arbeitest eng mit deinem festen Entwicklungsteam zusammen, bist deren primäre Ansprechperson für inhaltliche und produktbezogene Fragen und stellst sicher, dass das Team fokussiert, informiert und befähigt arbeiten kann 
 
 BRÜCKE ZWISCHEN PM UND ENTWICKLUNG SEIN  Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product Manager und UX/Design zusammen, moderierst Anforderungsprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass die Produktvision im Entwicklungsalltag greifbar und umsetzbar bleibt  
 BACKLOG MIT KLARHEIT FÜHREN  Du priorisierst und pflegst den Product Backlog in Azure DevOps, formulierst präzise Akzeptanzkriterien und Definition of Done und sorgst für Transparenz über Ziele und Fortschritt  
 SPASS HABEN  Du findest deinen Platz in einem vielfältigen, kollegialen Umfeld und freust dich darauf, ein spannendes Cloud-Produkt im Schnittfeld von Security, Big Data und KI mitzugestalten

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing Platform
jobs.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
 
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Product Manager, joining our Product team in the Fintech vertical. As a Billing Platform Product Manager, you will be a key member of our triad of product managers in the billing team, each leading their independent teams yet working within an interconnected scope.

As a Product Manager at Remote, you'll be developing and guiding our strategy for a key product area in Finance. You'll advance this vision by working with a cross-functional engineering and design group to find our most important problems and shape iterative solutions towards them.

What you bring

  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements
  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken.
  • Bonus: Experience working in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.
 Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.
 We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.
 Your mission 
 You own the product and the priorities behind it. The hard part of that job here is structural: our go-to-market runs vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt.
 You sit between Sales and Engineering and translate in both directions. Towards Sales: which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim. Towards Engineering: which requirement is ready to be built, what it needs to be complete, and what we deliberately leave out.
 This is an early-stage role and we expect you to shape it rather than inherit it. We are extending the core of the application right now, which means your first decisions land while the product is still taking form. At the beginning, a meaningful part of your work will be spent on customer projects, close to the people whose decisions we model. That is where you see which patterns are worth turning into product.
 We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, wild workload, and a go to market with the product and its tech that is a day to day focus and iteration process.
 What you'll own 
 The product roadmap and the reasoning behind it: what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.
 The boundary between standard product, configuration, and manual work for one customer.
 Requirements that engineering can build from: scope, acceptance criteria, and a clear statement of what is out.
 What we can credibly promise a customer, including where the product's limits currently are.
 Proofs of Value that you run yourself, and responsibility for individual accounts.
 Prototypes you build to test features with customers before we commit engineering time.
 How product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.

 Your number: how much of what is project work today is standard product a year from now, and the time from a recognised customer problem to a usable capability. 
 This role is not for you if your strength is backlog, process and ceremonies, if you need research and design capacity before you can decide, if a complex industrial domain is an obstacle rather than the interesting part, if you don't like data or if you need more than three days before your first customer conversation.
 Requirements 
 A technical and analytical foundation, engineering, data analytics, data science, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling from a technical degree, technical consulting, or technical product management. You will not write production code, but you need to recognise when a requirement creates technical debt, or is built in a way that cannot be reused at the next customer.
 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. More important than the title: you have owned a product area end to end before, not only a backlog.
 Experience deciding under incomplete information, and the ability to explain your trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
 You can sit with a plant manager or a controller, understand how they decide today, and leave the room knowing what the product has to do about it.
 Good to have, not a cut off: optimization experience, deeper knowledge in manufacturing, supply chain or S&OP, enterprise B2B sales cycles involving operations, IT and controlling, or early-stage startup experience.
 German C1 or higher, fluent in English.
 NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.
 Benefits 
 Impact. You work with substance and lead what the product becomes.
 Ownership. You define how product works here: what we build, what we decline, and where the boundary between product and project sits. No approval loops.
 The people next to you. You work directly with the researchers and modellers, have access to tech deliveries and execute and build on eye level with the founders.
 Exposure. You present your own roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, you sit in the core strategy conversations, and you stand in front of the people whose decisions we model.
 Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
 High stakes. Compe

Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

Learn  more about our Product & Tech team!

 Deine Position As Product Manager Procurement & Portfolio Management, you take on one of the most strategically defining product roles within our energy retail business: you design how 1KOMMA5° procures, hedges, and optimizes electricity for an increasingly flexible customer portfolio. You sit at the intersection of energy markets, energy procurement, our flexibility assets, and our customer-facing tariff strategy - and you turn this into a measurable commercial advantage. 
 Own our Procurement Strategy:  Define how and where 1KOMMA5° procures energy for our customer portfolio - across day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets. Develop a clear market split logic, and continuously refine it based on portfolio characteristics, customer mix, and market conditions. 

 Design Portfolio Hedging & Risk Management:  Build hedging and risk management strategies tailored to different customer portfolios (dynamic vs fixed tariffs or flexibility/ancillary services). Define when and how we lock in volumes, what we leave open, and how we balance commercial upside against risk exposure. 

 Shape Our Flexibility Procurement Model:  Design how we procure and steer our flexibility portfolio. Defining models such as flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price-based offers, and the trade-offs between them. Develop the commercial logic and the operational requirements for each model. 

 Run Quantitative Portfolio Analysis:  Independently run analyses on procurement performance, hedging effectiveness, and portfolio economics. Build the analytical foundation that supports strategic decisions, identifies optimization opportunities, and quantifies the impact of changes to our procurement and steering setup. 

 Monitor Performance and Drive Continuous Improvement:  Define KPIs across procurement cost, hedge effectiveness, portfolio risk, and flexibility margin. Use data to continuously sharpen our market positioning and commercial performance.

 4+ years of experience in (international) energy procurement, portfolio management, or energy trading, ideally in a utility, energy retailer, trading desk, or aggregator environment

 Proven ability to translate market and commercial logic into structured processes and product requirements 

 Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving market environment 

 Excellent written and spoken English and German 

 Market & Domain Expertise: 
 Deep understanding of European power markets - day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets - and the mechanisms that drive prices 

 Solid working knowledge of hedging instruments (futures, options, OTC), balancing markets, and BRP settlement 

 Familiarity with flexibility products and procurement models (flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price offers) and their commercial trade-offs 

 Awareness of regulatory frameworks shaping energy retail (Marktkommunikationsprozesse, balancing regimes, market design developments) 

 Experience working with external procurement partners, ETRM systems, or trading platforms is a strong plus

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are 

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

 Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

 About the role: 

 Fuel and energy are among the largest controllable costs any fleet carries, yet most operators still make those decisions with partial data and disconnected tools. Samsara already sees how these fleets actually run and that data is the raw material for a new generation of cost-optimization products.

 As a Senior Product Manager on this team, you'll own a product area end to end and turn that operational data into products the world's largest fleets rely on to cut fuel spend, run more efficiently, and navigate the shift to electric. Our portfolio spans fuel cost optimization (fuel cards, bulk fuel, partner programs), driver and vehicle efficiency, EVs and energy transition, as well as operational cost intelligence.

 The exact area you own will be shaped by your strengths and where the team needs you most at the time of joining. In every case, you'll work at the intersection of operational data, financial outcomes, and fleet performance, partnering closely with engineering, design, data science, business development, and go-to-market to ship products that turn Samsara's telematics platform into a cost-optimization and energy-management engine for the world's largest fleets.

 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. 
 

 You should apply if: 

 
 You want your work to move the physical economy: The products you ship will help real fleets spend less on fuel, waste less energy, and keep goods and people moving.

 You want real ownership: You'll own a product area's vision, strategy, and roadmap. If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages your personal development and rewards ownership.

 You're drawn to hard, open-ended problems: Much of this space has no playbook yet, especially as we ship AI-powered products into workflows that have never had them.

 You appreciate candid feedback and an experimental mindset : Samsara employees challenge the status quo and recognize failure as part of the learning process. We encourage each other to be honest and hold ourselves to high standards.

 
 In this role, you will: 

 
 Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a key product area, which may include fuel cost optimization, fleet efficiency, energy management, or operational cost intelligence.

 Translate Samsara's operational data (telematics, fuel consumption, idling, routing, vehicle health) into products that help customers reduce costs and improve fleet performance.

 Run deep discovery with the people who live these problems: fleet owners, fuel managers, operations leaders, and finance teams.

 Prototype and design MVPs yourself - clickable flows, working demos, rough cuts, often AI-assisted - to pressure-test ideas with customers before committing engineering time.

 Ship end-to-end experiences with design, engineering, and data science - from backend pipelines and partner integrations to the dashboards and mobile surfaces customers use every day.

 Define success metrics, build business cases for new initiatives, and drive a continuous cycle of experimentation and iteration grounded in data and customer feedback.

 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. 

 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 

 
 5+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping products used by real customers at scale.

 You can point to something you designed, prototyped or built yourself and a cross-functional launch you drove end to end; you have both the maker and the operator in you.

 You're hands-on with data: you can find what you need, build a way to measure what isn't being measured, define the KPIs that matter, and work as an equal with data science. 

 Strong

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Banking / Fintech / Consulting)
jobs.description:
Thoughtworks partners with clients to build impactful digital products which deliver extraordinary customer experiences. We do this by integrating design, strategy and technology. We’re looking for a seasoned product leader, with experience in identifying, launching and scaling new products and product portfolio and with a background in Banking / Financial Services / Fintech and Consulting to join the Customer Experience, Product and Design (CXPD) service line.

Job responsibilities

  • As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide advice and hands-on expertise on taking new products from concept to market to scale.
  • Drive the innovation mindset and the overall product development lifecycle, utilising lean and hypothesis driven approaches to identify, conceptualise and pilot new products that deliver undeniable value. 
  • Establish the market & competitive landscape, go to market strategy and business case or economic model for the opportunity with our clients. 
  • Lead the stakeholders to think about customer’s problems, business outcomes and take them on the change journey of moving to empowered product teams that create strategic growth for the organisation.
  • Shape and lead teams to deliver client engagements in a way which is both effective for our client and operationally sound for Thoughtworks.
  • Help shape CXPD service line value propositions, creating case studies, points of view and other content through insights on client needs and solutions, and also through defining repeatable practices which will help us to scale our efforts.
  • Get involved in pre-sales, creating proposals and pitches, shaping engagements for clients and helping to educate both clients and colleagues about the value of our services.
  • Contribute to the growth and scale of our evolving business through taking an active part in recruiting, community building, mentorship and driving continuous improvement in practices and techniques.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in leading new ideas from concept to launch and scale with expertise in go-to-market strategy and developing new revenue streams.
  • Experience in commercial and economic modelling, including monetisation strategy.
  • Experience in bringing an innovation mindset into an organisation at scale and creating sustained innovation investment across strategic horizons.
  • Depth in conducting research and bringing market trends, customer and competitive insights to facilitate strategic ideation to identify opportunities for strategic growth.
  • Depth and expertise in developing value proposition, using lean approaches to test viability, feasibility and desirable to achieve problem-solution and product-market fit before scaling.
  • Demonstrated hypothesis and data driven problem-solving orientation with exceptional ability to create structured quantitative and qualitative analyses.
  • Operate at company, portfolio and product level — defining and executing a strategy, shaping a vision and translating it into a roadmap with clear business and customer value-based measures of success.
  • Advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive the change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery and measurement and making innovation mainstream.
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices.

jobs.description:
You will build payment infrastructure for a sector that is running out of capacity and we are all depending on. 

 By 2050, 38 million people across the EU will need long-term care, and the sector already lacks the workforce to deliver it. Care organisations need technology that gives professionals more time for people. We build the payment infrastructure that makes this possible. 

 Your job: build and ship the products for it. 

 Parto is the all-in-one payments platform for social care organisations. We digitise cash, expense, and payment processes in youth services, disability support, and elderly care - making them simple, secure, and fully digital.

 With Parto Visa cards and our software platform, care professionals can efficiently manage client funds, team budgets, and everyday operational expenses. We reduce administrative work, eliminate disconnected processes, and create lasting relief for care teams, administration, and finance departments.

 Parto is backed by Motive Ventures New York/Berlin, Heal Capital Berlin and Shapers Lisbon, plus experienced business angels. 

 You will join an ambitious team whose experience includes Trade Republic, JPMorgan Chase, CHECK24 Bank, Strategy&, and Ruuky . Together, we are building a new category of financial software for one of society's most important sectors.

 Tasks

 As Product Manager at Parto , you will play a defining role in the future of our platform.

 You will be our second product manager, working directly with our founder and CPO, alongside a product designer and an engineering team of 11. Small team, large surface area: your decisions ship.

 You will build digital financial products for the social care sector and help modernise an industry that urgently needs better technology. Your work will solve real problems and shape how thousands of professionals manage money every day .

 This is not a role in which requirements are handed to you. You will own initiatives from the first customer insight through discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement .

 You will work AI-native from day one . Every PM at Parto uses AI agents daily for discovery, analysis, specs, and delivery. We expect you to push what a single PM can own.

 Together with engineering and product design, you will ensure that we solve the right problems and turn them into products that create measurable value.

 Your responsibilities include:

 
 Develop a deeper understanding of our users, their workflows, and their constraints than anyone else in the company.

 Translate customer conversations, user feedback, product data, regulatory requirements, and company goals into clear product decisions.

 Own and prioritise your roadmap based on outcomes and strategic leverage, and make difficult scope decisions while keeping your team moving at high speed.

 Lead discovery and turn ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, requirements, and measures of success.

 Work closely with engineering and product design from the earliest idea through launch, adoption, and iteration.

 Own integrations with external partners and third-party systems, including the operational details required to make them successful.

 Contribute to Parto's long-term product strategy and help define the category we intend to lead.

 
 What success looks like in your first six months 

 Months 1-2: Understand and take ownership 

 You develop a detailed understanding of our users, product, business model, and technology. You establish strong relationships with customers and your engineering counterparts, challenge existing assumptions, and take ownership of your first product area.

 Months 3-4: Ship and learn 

 You lead your first meaningful initiative from problem definition to launch. You establish clear success metrics, remove blockers quickly, and build a direct feedback loop between customers and the product team.

 Months 5-6: Raise the bar 

 You independently drive your roadmap, make difficult prioritisation decisions, and demonstrate measurable impact. Your understanding of customers begins to shape Parto's broader product strategy.

 We work with real startup intensity. The pace is high, the problems are unsolved, and the learning curve is steep. If you are looking for a quiet position with fixed instructions and a rigid scope, you will not be happy at Parto.

 If you want to build a product category from the ground up, take real responsibility, and become better at your craft faster than almost anywhere else, we would love to meet you.

 You make consequential decisions yourself and take responsibility for the results.

 You create clarity instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

 You move quickly without compromising on the quality of important decisions.

 You adapt when new evidence challenges the current plan.

Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

How you'll make an impact

You will play a pivotal role in shaping Dataiku's product positioning, roadmap, and requirements for predictive analytics, machine learning, and GenAI under the responsibilities of the Director of Product Management in charge of Dataiku AI/ML offering. You will work with stakeholders across all parts of the business, including Engineering, Product, GTM, Partners, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success teams, to execute growth projects and new products and features.

Your challenge is to identify and shape net new capabilities: innovations that are core additions to the product, discovered through deep customer engagement and validated before engineering commits. You are not here to maintain what exists in the long run, you will work with Technical Product Managers. You are here to find what's missing and make the case for building it.

If you're ready to step into a role where your expertise leads to tangible, wide-scale impact, where every insight you gather shapes the future of our products, we're waiting for you!

What you’ll be doing

  • Embed with strategic customers to run structured discovery (interviews, async collaboration, or on-site visits) to surface unmet needs before they're obvious to competitors.
  • Analyze usage and customer data to identify gaps and opportunities to enhance customer success and to deliver new capabilities with distinct business value propositions, ultimately contributing to the company's financial goals.
  • Analyze market forces and competition, engage with industry analysts and Dataiku teams to execute on Dataiku’s product strategy. Collaborate with the Product Marketing team to align and deliver on product positioning messages.
  • Build working prototypes (UI mockups, agentic pipeline demos, opportunity memos) to validate hypotheses with customers before engineering commits.
  • Synthesize field signals across accounts to distinguish incremental customer requests from genuine innovation opportunities (net new capabilities that would be core additions to the platform.)
  • Define and champion innovation initiatives from discovery through to launch, at which point ownership transitions to Technical Product Managers for ongoing improvements and maintenance.
  • At launch, partner with Technical Product Managers to produce enablement material for internal customers (Product Marketing and GTM Enablement) ensuring new capabilities and big delighters land with the right positioning, messaging, and field readiness.
  • Maintain the product backlog for the initiatives you own, constantly anticipating and aligning with the global product strategy and the software engineering delivery capacity.
  • Participate in the development, maintenance and education on the AI/ML roadmap. Articulate your team’s technology vision, requirements, goals and milestones to stakeholders.

What you will NOT be doing

  • Managing the full lifecycle of every feature you touch, your focus ends when a capability reaches steady state. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Organic Growth
jobs.description:
The Opportunity 

 

HelloFresh is the world's leading meal-kit company, serving millions of subscribers across 18 markets. Historically, we have grown through paid acquisition, but the way people discover food is changing twice over. Search is being reshaped by AI, and a new generation of consumers is asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity to "plan dinner for my family this week" instead of opening an app or a search engine. Whoever shows up in those answers wins the category-default position. Whoever does not is invisible.

We own the meal-kit category in organic search and in LLMs. The broader food and recipe universe, where 150M+ monthly searches live, is still dominated by publishers with decades of content authority. Closing that gap is one of the largest, most durable growth opportunities in the business, and it is the mandate of the Organic Growth squad.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead Organic Growth and level it up from a traditional SEO function into a modern organic discovery engine spanning SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and an emerging Agentic Commerce mandate. This is the single-threaded leadership role for how HelloFresh and Factor get discovered, cited, and chosen across Google and AI surfaces.

 

The role 

 

You will own the end-to-end product strategy for organic discovery technical SEO, content infrastructure at scale, GEO and AI visibility, and the early Agentic Commerce surface that turns discovery into action inside LLMs. You'll inherit a real foundation: a quality-first content strategy, recipe-collection automation, a GEO editorial framework, and a shipped Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App proof-of-concept. Your job is to take that to a responsible scale. You will set the direction for a cross-functional squad Product, Engineering, Data/ML, SEO, Content/Editorial, and UX and act as the connective tissue across Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial. You will operate with high agency and a strong bias for ownership: this role is for a builder who takes accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.

 

What you'll own 

 

SEO-the engine 

  • End-to-end technical and content SEO across HelloFresh and Factor: crawlability, indexation, structured data, internal linking, SSR, sitemaps, and CMS/content-platform infrastructure.
  • Content scale with guardrails: recipe detail pages, automated recipe collection pages, editorial/blog, recipe internationalization, and UGC signals (ratings, reviews, authorship) — growing the footprint without falling into the content-debt trap.
  • Move the org from meal-kit catalog to food destination: identify high-volume recipe and food queries where we have no page, and build them.

 

GEO-the next surface 

  • Own AI visibility and citation share across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, measured via Profound across a priority set of food and meal-kit prompts.
  • Drive our +25ppt GEO Visibility Score target (HF + Factor) by EOY 2026 through GEO-specific content formats built for AI citation, narrative-shaping editorial, and coordinated signals across owned, editorial, PR/affiliate, and social surfaces.
  • Operationalize "good SEO is good GEO" while owning the GEO-only tactics (comparison/listicle content, third-party narrative, non-Google LLM optimization) that pure SEO misses.

 

Agentic Commerce-the emerging bet 

  • Extend organic discovery from "showing up" to "converting": connect GEO presence to our Agentic Commerce surface so discovery in an LLM turns into action.
  • Partner with New Ventures on the Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App and the hub-and-spoke platform (MCP / Apps SDK, then Claude and Gemini), helping shape funnel and active-experience coverage as the space matures.

 

Connect discovery to engagement

  • Route food-intent traffic into the Cooking Companion / Cookbook experience (web-to-app save, cook-along, shopping lists) to build daily active users, not just sessions.
  • Own one integrated, prioritized organic-discovery roadmap that keeps content, product, engineering, data, and AI measurement connected.

 

Raise the bar & lead through influence

  • Set the standard for product thinking, experimentation rigor, and quality-first sequencing across the squad.
  • Drive alignment across Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial on a single repeated message and a shared definition of organic success.

 

What you'll bring 

 

  • Deep SEO expertise (must-have): 6+ years in product management with hands-on ownership of technical and content SEO

jobs.description:
Location: Remote / Hybrid (UK)
 Job Type: Full-time
 Salary: Â£65k - Â£80k, dependent on experience 

Shape the Future of Service Management 

 For more than 36 years, Marval has been at the forefront of Service Management innovation. As one of the original co-authors of ITIL, we've helped define the standards that organisations across the globe still rely on today. Now, we're building on that legacy.
 

 Our intelligent, no-code ITSM, ESM and Managed Service Management solutions empower organisations worldwide to transform the way they deliver services. As we continue to evolve our platform and accelerate our product strategy, we're looking for an ambitious Product Manager who wants to make a real impact.
 If you thrive in flexible, fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex customer problems and want genuine ownership of product decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity 

 As a Product Manager at Marval, you'll own a key area of our product roadmap from discovery through to delivery, launch and continuous improvement. This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog or write requirements. We're looking for someone who loves talking to customers, validating ideas, challenging assumptions and working side-by-side with Development, Customer Success and Sales to build products that solve real problems. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, influence product strategy and help shape the future of our platform.
 

What You'll Be Doing 

 Own the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery through to launch and ongoing optimisation.
 Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify genuine business problems and opportunities.
 Prioritise features based on customer value, business goals and technical considerations.
 Create clear product specifications and user stories that enable successful delivery.
 Collaborate with Development throughout the development lifecycle, making informed trade-off decisions where required.
 Analyse product performance, customer feedback and usage data to continually improve the user experience.
 Communicate roadmap priorities, progress and strategic direction across the business.
 Help develop and improve Product Management processes, tooling and ways of working as we continue to scale.
 

Skills and Experience 

 We're more interested in how you think, solve problems and collaborate with others.
 

 You'll ideally have:
 

 At least four years' experience in Product Management within B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software or a similar technology environment.
 A strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM) or Service Management solutions.
 Experience delivering successful software features that have improved customer adoption, engagement, retention or revenue.
 Experience working within Agile product development teams.
 Strong communication skills with the confidence to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
 A customer-first mindset with excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

 We'd love it if you also have: 

 Experience with no-code or low-code platforms.
 Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment or have that mindset.
 Exposure to global customer markets.
 A passion for modern product management and continuous improvement.
 

Why Join Marval? 

 This is an opportunity to join a business with a proud heritage while helping shape its future.
 

 At Marval, you'll enjoy:
 

 Real ownership of product decisions and roadmap priorities.
 The opportunity to influence products used by organisations around the world.
 Flexible remote and hybrid working.
 A collaborative, supportive team that values innovation and fresh thinking.
 The stability of an established software company combined with the pace and ambition of a growing technology business.
 Ongoing opportunities for professional development and career progression.

 About You 

 You're someone who:
 

 Is comfortable making decisions without having every piece of information.
 Enjoys asking "why?" and digging beneath customer requests to uncover the real problem.
 Works well with ambiguity and enjoys creating clarity where none exists.
 Values collaboration and constructive challenge.
 Takes ownership, learns quickly and isn't afraid to adapt when priorities change.
 Wants to build products that customers genuinely love using.
